annotations.title: Create a project on this computer

description: Create a project on this computer. Writes a template (3d-basic by default) to a folder, no shell needed. Returns projectPath. Next: summer_projects_open_local.

dir.description: The project folder: a new or empty folder, not inside another project; ~ is home. Default <name> next to the session's project, in the session's folder, or in ~/Documents/Summer.

name.description: The project's name and folder name. Default my-game (or the template's name).
